notes: This is the author's table of contents for material headed Structure à l'infinity des M_{g,nu}. It lists standard curves (spelled standart), associated graphs and maquettes, stable curves and MD-graphs, Mumford-Deligne theory, specialization and generisation, low-dimensional strata, groupoidal and analytic MDT structures, and three digressions. This is a transcription summary, not an independent mathematical check.

Right-hand references were individually read as1,3,6,10,15,16-prime,25,29-prime,37,45,52,74,86. The lower-left 2 is separate bottom pagination, not another contents reference. The primes on16 and29 are retained.

Entry4 visibly says théorie, while its article remains doubtful between Le and La. Entry9 reads variables and cas transcendant. The technical words générisation (entries6 and9) and normalisation (entry10) are retained as written; H's généralisation is not used.
The title's subscript and the later hatted-M subscript were inspected independently. The later comma/nu trace is not supplied from the title; its uncertainty is broadened to the whole subscript.

The only insertion is the quoted locales above entry13, with a placement stroke between stratifications and générales. The long loops below letters elsewhere are letter descenders, not deletions. The whole heading has an underline.

H's dashes separating entry text from page references and its enumerate/italic wrappers are layout/editorial encoding, not extra source text or disagreements. H's closing section heading belongs to the next page according to the main reader's independent review; it is not transcribed or logged as an extra-text error here. Reader A did not inspect that next page.

Brown right-margin specks/stains are not punctuation. There is no additional lower heading on this sheet. All original words, digits, symbols, indices and the insertion were checked visually from the original and two prepared halves; all16 first-pass crops were opened. No OCR, external source, proof verification or TeX compilation was used.
